svg.aria-label: alignment_metrics per-thread metrics worker: super-region parallelization, per-read pileup accumulation via CIGAR walk, and metrics aggregation
svg.text: Regions of interest are partitioned into super regions; each thread runs a metrics worker that processes one super region at a time.
The worker fetches reads overlapping the super region and walks each read in sorted order, accumulating per-position pileup entries.
